_note: Each task is scoped so the build loop can implement + test it in one pass. Order matters: foundations first. Set status back to 'pending' to rebuild a task.

tasks.title: Backend scaffold + health check
tasks.spec: Stand up the API service (Node/Express or Fastify) with a Postgres connection layer, env config, and a GET /health endpoint returning {status:'ok', db:true}. Include a test runner (jest or vitest) wired to `npm test`.
acceptance: GET /health returns 200 with db connectivity flag
npm test runs and passes at least one test

tasks.title: Auth + roles (customer/worker/founder)
tasks.spec: Add a users table and role enum (customer, worker, founder, admin). Phone number is the identity (matches WhatsApp). Implement role lookup by phone and a requireRole() guard. No passwords — identity is proven by the WhatsApp bridge upstream; the API trusts a signed internal token.
acceptance: users table with role column exists via migration
requireRole() rejects wrong role with 403
lookup-by-phone returns the user's role

tasks.title: Projects, phases, milestones
tasks.spec: Core domain: Project (name, address, client, status, budget), Phase (belongs to project, ordered), Milestone (belongs to phase, due date, % complete). CRUD endpoints, role-gated: founders write, customers read their own projects, workers read assigned projects.
acceptance: CRUD endpoints for project/phase/milestone return correct status codes
customer can only read their own project (404/403 otherwise)
migrations create all three tables

tasks.title: Daily site log + photo attachments
tasks.spec: Workers post a daily log per project: text note, weather, crew count, hours, and 0..N photo references (media stored via the WhatsApp media path / object storage, log keeps the URL/key). Customers and founders can read logs for their projects.
acceptance: worker can create a daily log with photo refs
logs are listable per project, newest first
customer reading another project's logs is denied

tasks.title: Tasks + assignment + status
tasks.spec: Work items assigned to workers within a project/phase: title, assignee, due date, status (todo/doing/blocked/done), priority. Workers update status; founders assign. Status changes are timestamped for an audit trail.
acceptance: task can be created, assigned, and transitioned through statuses
status history is recorded
only assignee or founder can change a task

tasks.title: Materials & procurement requests
tasks.spec: Workers raise material requests (item, qty, project, urgency). Founders approve/deny. Approved requests become a procurement list with status (requested/ordered/delivered).
acceptance: worker creates a material request
founder approval moves it to ordered
procurement list filters by status and project

tasks.title: Budget, change orders & approvals
tasks.spec: Project budget with line items, actuals vs. estimate. Change orders (description, cost delta, requires customer approval). Customer approve/reject is recorded with timestamp and becomes part of the project's financial record.
acceptance: budget shows estimate vs actual per line
change order requires explicit customer approval before affecting budget
rejected change orders do not alter the budget

tasks.title: Notifications & escalation engine
tasks.spec: An event bus that emits domain events (log posted, task blocked, change order pending, milestone due/overdue) and routes them to the right WhatsApp recipients by role and project membership. Pluggable sender interface so the WhatsApp bridge is the first implementation.
acceptance: emitting an event resolves the correct recipient set by role+project
overdue milestone triggers an escalation event
sender interface is mockable in tests

tasks.title: WhatsApp command router (role-aware menus)
tasks.spec: Map inbound WhatsApp commands to API calls, gated by the sender's role and the configurator's per-contact menu. Customers: 'estado', 'fotos', 'aprovar'. Workers: 'log', 'tarefa', 'material'. Founders: 'painel', 'aprovacoes', 'equipa'. Reuses the existing watcher + configurator allowlist/menu config.
acceptance: a worker 'log' command creates a daily log via the API
a customer cannot invoke a worker-only command
menu shown matches the contact's configured permission

tasks.title: Founder dashboard summary (AI rollup)
tasks.spec: A 'painel' command returns a concise health summary per project: % complete, overdue tasks, pending approvals, budget variance, last activity. Aggregates from the API; the natural-language phrasing is produced by a cheap model call.
acceptance: dashboard endpoint aggregates the right metrics per project
summary degrades gracefully when a project has no data
founder-only access enforced
